items.title: Z — белая кисть
items.art: one single large Latin Z painted in matte chalk white with a wide house brush, uneven bristle strokes, few dry gaps, no text beyond Z; raw improvised military vehicle-style marking transferred to a wall

items.title: V — полевой трафарет
items.art: one bold Latin V in a broad olive-drab field of broken stencil paint, stencil bridges, dusty black inside, angular compact composition, no additional words

items.title: O — меловая метка
items.art: one large white O ring, broken rough hand chalk circle with faded edges, a small exact 2022 in thin chalk under its right edge, restrained minimalist military marking

items.title: Z в квадрате
items.art: one white Latin Z inside a hand-painted square white border, deliberately uneven corners, patchy older paint and one thin trickle, no other text

items.title: V — аэрозольная метка
items.art: one large white Latin V loosely surrounded by a black incomplete ring with olive dry brush strokes, asymmetrical military aerosol marking, soft overspray, no text

items.title: СВО 2022
items.art: exact text СВО on the top line and 2022 on bottom, compact authentic rough olive military stencil, small white Z at the left, heavily faded cream underline

items.title: КОЛОННА →
items.art: exact Russian text КОЛОННА with long directional arrow pointing right, small white Z in a square at left, thin off-white chalk and brush, wide impromptu military route marking

items.title: ВОЕННАЯ ПОЛИЦИЯ
items.art: exact Russian text ВОЕННАЯ ПОЛИЦИЯ in two lines of worn red stencilled capitals, small white Latin V beside lettering, distressed black rectangular line frame, matte pigment

items.title: БЛОКПОСТ 2022
items.art: exact Russian text БЛОКПОСТ on top and 2022 small below, faded yellow olive block stencil, rough white Latin Z to right, two short red horizontal brush strokes to left, checkpoint marking

items.title: Z / V — следы 2022
items.art: a large coarse black Latin Z partially overpainted by a later dirty ivory Latin V, small correct 2022 at lower right, layered improvised military paint, older Z rubbed away in places and fresher V has dry brush texture, no other text
